text:
devon: quick ping — PR #1289 is ready for final review, needs runtime + infra + security sign-off before we merge. target merge: Weds 8pm PT. link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/1289

tara: sending eyes now. is there a short checklist on what runtime should validate? perf regressions, kv cache safety? :eyes:

devon: mainly 3 things for runtime: 1) confirm no regressions for sequential batching, 2) KV cache invalidation for model switching, 3) fallback route preserves latency SLOs. small perf test included in PR description.

samir: fyi this touches the eviction header handling in the orch layer — infra needs a quick staging run. can we gate with a canary? also need a config flag to flip back.

devon: yep added `orch.evict_header_compat` flag (default true). snippet in PR: ```yaml
orch: 
  evict_header_compat: true
```

elena: security quick notes: I need the threat model update + confirmation that request headers with auth tokens aren't logged. also want to see the audit-log entries for the new route. can you paste the audit example here?

devon: pasted audit example in PR comments: ```json
{"event":"route.fallback","route":"/models/fallback","user":null,"src":"orch"}``` not logging auth headers. added unit test to assert no token capture.

maya: scheduling note — if you want Weds 8pm PT merge, eng-sre needs a 30m pre-merge window for canary and rollback plan. cc @eng-sre-bot for auto-schedule.

eng-sre-bot: scheduled canary window for 2024-03-20 19:30-20:00 PT. rollback window 20:00-20:15.

tara: quick code request for runtime: can you add a small perf microbenchmark in `bench/kv_switch_bench.py` that runs short sequences? saves time in review.

devon: will add it in a follow-up commit in the branch — PR updated with TODO + ETA 2h.

samir: infra note: I'll run staging post-merge if we need a hotfix, but prefer canary first. I also want a quick smoke script: `scripts/smoke_orch_eviction.sh` — can someone add?

devon: adding the smoke script in this branch as well, pushed in c3f9d2.

elena: once the threat model and audit examples are in the PR description I'll approve from sec side. please @me when updated.

tara: ran unit tests locally, a couple of minor nits inline. nothing blocking for runtime approval after fixes.

devon: addressed nits and pushed fix. updated PR description with threat model + audit example. @elena can you re-check?

elena: rechecked, threat model looks good, audit examples sufficient. approving from my side. :white_check_mark:

tara: runtime approved. :rocket:

samir: infra approved post-canary. will monitor.

devon: thanks all — scheduling merge for Weds 8pm PT per canary window. I'll follow up after canary completes with results. :tada:
